title: TransferUploadPart
description: Immutable byte-range receipt used to assemble a private transfer artifact.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

artifact_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

byte_length.description: Actual part bytes, capped at 64 MiB by default.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the exact named bytes.

x-invariants: A replay at one offset must match both bytes and size.
No overlapping offsets are allowed when assembled.
